meaning.zh: 嵌入問句是放在另一個句子內的問句，用來詢問、轉述、思考、解釋、調查或討論未知資料。

rules.zh: 固定學習目標是「嵌入問句」，不是某一個主句框架 本課的核心不是只背誦： I asked whether ... 真正的核心結構是： question word + subject + verb 或： whether / if + subject + verb 嵌入問句可以放在很多不同框架之後。 After verbs 動詞之後 I wonder why he left. （我想知道他為甚麼離開。） We need to find out when the shop closes. （我們需要查明商店何時關門。） The guide explained how the machine worked. （導遊解釋了機器如何運作。） After adjective expressions 形容詞表達之後 I am not sure whether the door is locked. （我不確定門是否已上鎖。） It is unclear who approved the change. （目前不清楚是誰批准了這項改動。） After nouns or linking structures 名詞或連繫結構之後 The question is whether the plan will work. （問題是這項計劃能否奏效。） The main issue is why the system failed. （主要問題是系統為甚麼失靈。） After prepositions 介詞之後 It depends on whether the weather improves. （這取決於天氣會否好轉。） There is some doubt about whether the figures are accurate. （目前仍有人懷疑這些數字是否準確。） In polite questions 禮貌問句之中 Could you tell me where the office is? （你可以告訴我辦公室在哪裏嗎？） Do you know when the meeting begins? （你知道會議何時開始嗎？） 因此，以下框架都可以成為答案的一部分： ● I asked ... ● I wonder ... ● Do you know ...? ● Could you tell me ...? ● Please check ... ● We need to find out ... ● No one knows ... ● It is unclear ... ● The question is ... ● It depends on ... ● The report explains ... ● We have not decided ... 它們只是可以容納嵌入問句的不同語法框架，不是固定句型本身。
rules.en: The fixed target is the embedded question itself, not one memorised main-clause frame. It may follow verbs, adjective expressions, nouns, linking structures, prepositions or polite openings.

rules.zh: 嵌入問句使用陳述句語序 直接問句通常把助動詞或 be 動詞放在主語前面。 Direct question: Where is Daniel? （丹尼爾在哪裏？） Embedded question: Do you know where Daniel is? （你知道丹尼爾在哪裏嗎？） 錯誤： Do you know where is Daniel? 嵌入部分應該使用： Daniel + is 而不是： is + Daniel
rules.en: Use statement word order inside an embedded question: “Do you know where Daniel is?”, not “where is Daniel”.

rules.zh: 不再使用問句中的 do、does 或 did Direct question: What does this word mean? （這個字是甚麼意思？） Embedded question: Could you explain what this word means? （你可以解釋這個字是甚麼意思嗎？） 錯誤： Could you explain what does this word mean? Direct question: Why did the system stop? （系統為甚麼停止運作？） Embedded question: We need to understand why the system stopped. （我們需要了解系統為甚麼停止運作。） 問句中的 did 消失，而 stopped 保持過去式。
rules.en: Remove question auxiliaries do, does and did from the embedded part, and inflect the lexical verb for the required tense.

rules.zh: 放在主語之後 Direct question: When will the results be announced? （結果何時公布？） Embedded question: Do you know when the results will be announced? （你知道結果何時公布嗎？） 不是： Do you know when will the results be announced?
rules.en: Place a modal verb after the subject inside the embedded question: “when the results will be announced”.

rules.zh: 問句使用 whether 或 if Direct question: Is the shop open? （商店正在營業嗎？） Embedded question: Please check whether the shop is open. （請查看商店是否正在營業。） 或： Please check if the shop is open. （請查看商店是否正在營業。） 在很多動詞後，whether 和 if 都可以使用： ● ask whether / if ● know whether / if ● wonder whether / if ● check whether / if ● find out whether / if
rules.en: Use whether or if to embed a yes-or-no question. Both are possible after many verbs such as ask, know, wonder, check and find out.

rules.zh: 在介詞之後通常使用 whether 正確： It depends on whether the weather improves. （這取決於天氣會否好轉。） There is uncertainty about whether the event will continue. （目前仍不確定活動會否繼續。） 不宜寫成： It depends on if the weather improves. 在正式或標準書面英語中，介詞後使用 whether 較穩妥。
rules.en: After a preposition, whether is normally the safer choice in formal or standard written English.

rules.zh: 或 what 本身是主語時，不需要改變語序 Direct question: Who broke the window? （誰打破了窗戶？） Embedded question: Nobody knows who broke the window. （沒有人知道是誰打破了窗戶。） 不是： Nobody knows who did break the window. 同樣： What caused the delay? （甚麼導致了延誤？） The report explains what caused the delay. （報告解釋了甚麼導致延誤。）
rules.en: When who or what is itself the subject, keep it directly before the verb and do not add do-support.

rules.zh: 標點取決於整個句子 如果整個句子是陳述句，句末使用句號。 I wonder where she is. （我想知道她在哪裏。） 如果整個句子是問句，句末使用問號。 Could you tell me where she is? （你可以告訴我她在哪裏嗎？） 嵌入部分表達疑問，並不代表整句一定使用問號。
rules.en: Punctuation depends on the whole sentence: use a full stop for a statement and a question mark when the entire sentence is a question.

rules.zh: 轉述過去的問話時，時態和代名詞可能需要改變 Direct question: “Have you taken the medicine?” the nurse asked me. （護士問我：「你服藥了嗎？」） Reported embedded question: The nurse asked me whether I had taken the medicine. （護士問我是否已經服藥。） Direct question: “What would you do?” the interviewer asked Nadia. （面試官問娜迪亞：「你會怎樣做？」） Reported embedded question: The interviewer asked Nadia what she would do. （面試官問娜迪亞會怎樣做。） 改寫時必須保留原本的時間、人物和意思。
rules.en: When reporting a past question, adjust tense and pronouns where necessary while preserving the original time, people and meaning.

rules.zh: 不包括 wh-word + to-infinitive 以下結構與嵌入問句有關，但並非本課的主要目標： I do not know what to do. （我不知道應該怎樣做。） She has not decided where to stay. （她尚未決定住在哪裏。） 本課集中練習有完整主語和動詞的嵌入問句： I do not know what I should do. （我不知道自己應該怎樣做。） She has not decided where she will stay. （她尚未決定將會住在哪裏。）
rules.en: This lesson excludes the related wh-word + to-infinitive pattern and focuses on embedded questions with a complete subject and verb.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能讓你更有禮貌地提出問題，而不是直接向對方發問。 Direct: Where is the manager? （經理在哪裏？） More polite: Could you tell me where the manager is? （你可以告訴我經理在哪裏嗎？） 第二種說法較柔和，特別適合與陌生人、顧客、老師或上司溝通。
benefits.en: It helps you ask questions more politely by placing a direct question after a softer opening.

benefits.zh: 你可以轉述另一個人提出的問題，不需要逐字重複原本的對話。 Direct speech: Amy asked, “When will the results arrive?” （艾米問：「結果何時會送達？」） Reported question: Amy asked when the results would arrive. （艾米問結果何時會送達。） 這在故事、報告、電郵和會議紀錄中十分實用。
benefits.en: It lets you report another person’s question without repeating the exact conversation.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以把「未知資料」和「需要採取的行動」連接起來。 We need to decide which route we will take. （我們需要決定將會採用哪一條路線。） Please check whether the door is locked. （請檢查門是否已上鎖。） 讀者可以清楚看出需要取得甚麼資料，以及為甚麼需要取得。
benefits.en: It connects an unknown fact with an action such as deciding, checking, explaining or investigating.

benefits.zh: 你可以使用嵌入問句，清楚指出正在研究、調查或討論的問題。 The committee is examining why the costs increased. （委員會正在研究成本為甚麼上升。） The main issue is whether the building is safe. （主要問題是大樓是否安全。） 這比只寫： The committee is examining the problem. （委員會正在研究這個問題。） 更加準確。
benefits.en: It helps organise investigations and discussions by identifying the exact issue being studied.

benefits.zh: 你不需要反覆使用直接問句，而可以透過不同動詞、形容詞、名詞和禮貌表達組織句子。 例如： ● I wonder why ... ● No one knows who ... ● It is unclear whether ... ● The question is how ... ● The result depends on whether ... ● Could you explain what ...? 這能令說話和寫作不會充滿完全相同的句子開頭。
benefits.en: It gives you more sentence variety through verbs, adjectives, nouns and polite expressions instead of repeated direct-question openings.

benefits.zh: 嵌入問句可以用於日常對話、顧客服務、面試、報告、研究和職場溝通。 日常用法： Do you know when the bus arrives? （你知道巴士何時到達嗎？） 正式用法： The investigation will determine whether the procedure was followed correctly. （調查將確定相關程序是否得到正確遵守。）
benefits.en: It is useful in both everyday and formal English, including conversations, customer service, interviews, reports, research and workplace communication.
